comment.comment: Preform comments are in square brackets, like Inform 7's, and nest.
comment.name: comment.block.preform

patterns.comment: A ?n after a nonterminal or brace group sets a production's ordering.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.order.preform

patterns.comment: A nonterminal being defined, at the start of a line.
patterns.name: entity.name.function.nonterminal.preform

patterns.comment: A slash joins alternative words: the/a/an.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.alternative.word.preform

patterns.comment: A leading underscore marks a word that must appear literally and is not part of the matched text: _and, _or.
patterns.name: string.other.literal.word.preform

patterns.comment: ^ negates: the following word must not appear.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.negation.preform

patterns.comment: A nonterminal used in a production.
patterns.name: variable.other.nonterminal.preform

patterns.comment: Wildcards: ### one word, *** any words, ... any text, ...... any text including punctuation.
patterns.name: support.variable.wildcard.preform
